items.title: Vegetable Tagine with Couscous and Olives
items.alt: An open terracotta tagine holds mixed vegetables beside a conical lid, a patterned couscous bowl and olives.
items.description: The warm clay dish sits behind two cream-and-blue bowls, with a narrow decorated lid leaning to its right.

items.title: Pizza Party Boxes with Salad and Drinks
items.alt: An open pizza box rests on another box beside a plated slice, a salad cup and two plain paper drinks.
items.description: The vegetable-topped pizza has a visible gap where the separate slice was removed, with the full upright lid behind it.

items.title: Two-Bowl Noodle Banquet Tray
items.alt: Two patterned noodle bowls sit on a black tray with a cream teapot and two pairs of resting chopsticks.
items.description: One bowl shows broth and egg halves, while the other contains noodles and vegetables, giving the compact meal two distinct focal points.

items.title: Loaded Baked Potato Sharing Dish
items.alt: Three open baked potatoes with different toppings fill a green handled dish beside grated cheese and cream.
items.description: Broccoli, beans and tomato distinguish the three fillings, with each split potato skin visible around its topping.

items.title: Glazed Ham with Potatoes and Asparagus
items.alt: A scored glazed ham with fanned slices sits on a white platter with potatoes, asparagus and apple wedges beside gravy.
items.description: Clove-like dark studs follow the diamond-cut glaze, contrasting with the pink cut face and pale slices at the front.

items.title: Pumpkin Soup Tureen with Bread
items.alt: A hollow pumpkin holds golden soup beside its stemmed lid, a small soup bowl and sliced bread.
items.description: Cream swirls and chopped green garnish decorate the soup, while the pumpkin’s ridged orange shell gives the serving vessel a clear outline.
